realization.note: One random realization of mill-study point-defect projection with physical footprints and same-side overlap merging. Re-running produces different results.

schemaNote: Each stem carries 'plot' and 'treeNum' tracing back to source data. Forked trees use decimal sub-IDs (e.g. '2-3.1', '2-3.2') for each fork in cut order, per real skidding/bucking practice. Stems flagged complexityTag='complex' involve forks and should be reviewed. Shape defects (sweep, crook) modeled geometrically in meta.shapeDefects as lateral centerline offset curves. Quality defects (section/sector/interior) in meta.qualityDefects as metadata only. Mill-study surface defects (meta.millDefectProjections) are modeled as POINT DEFECTS WITH PHYSICAL FOOTPRINT: each defect drawn from a matched real mill log (species+diameter+B/U, falling back to diameter+B/U if <15 matching logs; length-proximity bootstrap from 5 closest-length candidates) is assigned a random position along its segment and a footprint length sampled from its size class: le3in -> uniform(0.5,3.0)in, 3to6in -> uniform(3.0,6.0)in, gt6in -> uniform(6.0,12.0)in (EXPLICIT ASSUMPTION -- source data has no upper bound for this bucket). Defects placed independently per side (1-4) with random side rotation. Within each side only, overlapping/touching defect footprints are merged into a single mergedZone; defects on different sides are never merged. Both individualDefects and mergedZones retained per side. Schema for meta.millDefectProjections is a FIXED CONTRACT required by the downstream bucking training software (see Mill_Defect_Projection_Methodology.md Section 8): each projection has segStartHeightFt, segEndHeightFt, segmentLengthFt, and sides.side1-side4, each with defectCounts (le3in/3to6in/gt6in), individualDefects, and mergedZones (each zone with zoneStartIn, zoneEndIn, zoneLengthIn, memberDefectCount). SPECIES CODES: CH=Cherry, HM=Hard Maple, SM=Soft Maple, CO=Chestnut Oak, HK=Hickory, RO=Red Oak, WO=White Oak, YP=Yellow Poplar, WAL=Walnut are CONFIRMED. BO, SO, AB, SW, RM, SG, SY, DLM, SPS remain UNCONFIRMED -- stems using these codes always fall back to diameter+B/U matching since species-specific matching cannot be verified for them. See Stem_Reconstruction_Methodology.md Section 1.1 for the full crosswalk. *** THIS IS ONE REALIZATION *** -- mill defect projection uses true random sampling with NO fixed seed for log selection, side rotation, AND defect positioning/footprint sizing; re-running will produce DIFFERENT results even on identical stem geometry. Every projected defect carries a sourceMillLogRowId for traceability back to the exact row in Defect-Data.xlsx used. See Stem_Reconstruction_Methodology.md and Mill_Defect_Projection_Methodology.md for full details.
